name: T-Pose
description: Stand tall with arms stretched horizontally at shoulder height.

name: Arnold Double Bicep
description: Flex both biceps overhead like a bodybuilder.

name: Superman Stance
description: Stand tall and proud with both hands planted on your hips.

name: Military Salute
description: Stand at attention and salute with your right hand.

name: Touchdown Referee
description: Raise both arms straight up to signal a field goal.

name: The Dab
description: Tuck your head into your bent elbow while extending the other arm.

name: Disco Point Up
description: Point one arm diagonally high toward the sky, Saturday Night Fever style.

name: SRK Wide Open Arms
description: Spread both arms wide with head tilted back in true Bollywood romance.

name: The Shrug
description: Hold both hands open and palms up with a puzzled shrug.

name: Traffic Stop
description: Extend your left arm straight sideways to halt oncoming traffic.

name: Zombie Walk
description: Shuffle forward with both arms outstretched like an undead walker.

name: Side Bicep Flex
description: Turn slightly sideways and lock in a 3/4 single bicep flex.

name: Statue of Liberty
description: Hold your right fist high overhead holding Lady Liberty torch.

name: Boxing Guard
description: Keep your fists tight near your chin in a guarded fighter stance.

name: Hands Behind Head
description: Interlock both hands behind your head and relax in the sun.

name: Peace Sign
description: Raise your right hand flashing a two-finger peace sign.

name: Casual Lean
description: Lean casually with one hand pressed out against an invisible wall.

name: Victory V
description: Raise both arms high in a wide V celebrate your win!

name: Usain Bolt Lightning
description: Strike Usain Bolt iconic lightning bolt victory celebration.

name: Yoga Tree Pose
description: Balance on one leg with the other foot resting on your inner thigh and hands overhead.

name: Yoga Warrior II
description: Sink into a deep forward lunge with arms extended parallel to the floor.

name: Sumo Squat
description: Spread your feet wide, toes flared out, and lower down into a deep sumo squat.

name: High Knee Hug
description: Lift one knee high toward your chest and clasp it with both hands.

name: Michael Jackson Fedora Tilt
description: Cross your feet, tilt your fedora hat down, and pop your hip.

name: Baseball Pitcher Windup
description: Lift your lead knee high into a powerful baseball pitcher windup.

name: Kamehameha Charge
description: Cup both hands at your hip in a martial arts stance preparing a blast.

name: Naruto Shadow Clone
description: Cross your index and middle fingers in the classic shinobi clone seal.

name: Gojo Domain Expansion
description: Stand cool and cross your index and middle finger in Gojo signature pose.

name: Speed Skater Glide
description: Hinge forward at the hips with hands clasped behind your back in aerodynamic glide.

name: Karate Side Kick
description: Balance on one foot and chamber a fully extended horizontal side kick.

name: Skater Side Lunge
description: Lunge deep to one side touching your ankle with the opposite leg straight.

name: Kung Fu Crane
description: Perch on one standing leg with knee drawn up and wings spread wide.

name: Spider-Man Landing
description: Drop into a low 3-point spider hero landing with one hand on the floor.

name: Crouching Tiger Sword
description: Drop into a deep wushu crouch with your lead leg straight and arm sweeping high.

name: Breakdance Freeze
description: Plant your hands down and lock into a gravity-defying b-boy freeze.

name: Cheerleader Leg Lift
description: Kick one leg behind you and hold pom-poms high in a cheer jump.
